title: workload-clusterer-for-continuous-batching-recommendations-and-safe-rollout
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a workload clustering component ("Workload Clusterer") that profiles request streams, derives stable workload segments, and produces continuous batching + caching parameter recommendations. Integrate these recommendations with a safe, observable rollout path that supports canary applies, automated rollback triggers, and explicit audit logging. Goal: reduce per-token cost by identifying segment-specific batching configs while guaranteeing latency SLOs and correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Clusterer generates deterministic segments for a given profiling window with >85% temporal stability
Each segment recommendation includes: target max_batch_size, pad_strategy, kv_cache_ttl, batch_timeout_ms, expected_tokens_saved and estimated p99 latency change
Recommendations can be staged via Console (canary %) and applied automatically when thresholds are met
Automatic rollback triggers on: p99 latency regression > 20% relative, error-rate increase > 1%, or correctness signal degradation as defined by eval-set delta
End-to-end simulation tool demonstrates >= 12% median per-token cost reduction on two production-like workloads without breaking latency SLOs
notes: Different from current batch autotuners: this work focuses on segment-level continuous adaptation and an auditable safe-apply flow rather than global heuristics only.
We will intentionally decouple clustering frequency from rollout frequency: clusters update every profiling window (default 30m), recommendations push to staging every 6h unless manually overridden.
Profile features: arrival rate histogram, sequence length distribution, model variant, prefix cache hit ratios, client-side priority markers, geo-region
Conservative defaults: when uncertainty > threshold (low sample count or high variance), recommend 'no-change' and flag for human review.
implementation_steps: 1) Instrument a lightweight producer to emit per-request feature vectors (sampling at 1%) and aggregate into time-windowed sketches
2) Implement Offline Clusterer prototype (k-means + DBSCAN hybrid) in profiling service and evaluate stability metrics on last-quarter traces
3) Build recommendation engine that maps clusters -> candidate configs using a ruleset + small-scale microbenchmarks for latency/cost estimation
4) Expose recommendations in Console staging UI with % canary slider and expected savings estimate
5) Implement rollout controller: staged apply, adaptive canary ramp, monitoring hooks, and circuit-breaker rollback
6) Add audit log entries and an approval workflow for enterprise tenants (Private/Dedicated)
7) Run synthetic and shadow simulations against production traffic capture, iterate heuristics, and finalize default thresholds
tests: Unit tests for clusterer determinism and serialization
Integration test for recommendation -> simulate apply -> validate p50/p95/p99 latency and error rates
Chaos test: intentionally inject thin-provisioning to ensure rollback triggers fire
Long-run A/B test harness to measure real cost savings and false positive rollback rate
rollout_plan: Phase A (internal): run clusterer in observe-only mode for 2 weeks, collect stability metrics and false-positive signals
Phase B (staging): enable recommendation staging in Console for 10% internal traffic with canary applies and manual approvals
Phase C (gradual): enable automated canary ramping to 50% for low-risk segments with monitoring gates
Phase D (opt-in): GA expose to customers as 'Adaptive Batching (preview)' with opt-in and quota protections
Phase E (GA): default enable for new Dedicated pools with explicit opt-out and admin audit trail
rollback_plan: Immediate: controller pauses new applies and reverts to last-known-good config for affected segment
Automated rollback triggers: p99 latency increase > 20% OR error-rate spike > 1% OR eval-set quality drop > 2%
Manual escalation: notify oncall + PM + customer success for high-impact tenants
Postmortem checklist: capture profiling window, recommendation that applied, metrics around change, and produce remediation draft
signals_and_dashboards: Per-segment cost-per-token estimate and realized token savings
Recommendation confidence score and sample count
Audit log of who approved/applied and the diff of config
